system.description:
You manipulate fire, causing it to grow, shrink, or spread as you will.

When you cast this spell, choose an existing fire within 10 spaces of you. You can empower that fire to grow in intensity or snuff it out entirely.

You can cause something as small as a candle flame to erupt to fill a 5-space-radius, giving all affected spaces the Hazard (1) trait.

Alternatively, you can smother fires within a 5-space-radius around a point.

If there is an existing fire creating a Hazard, you can use this spell to increase or decrease the intensity one step (for example changing Hazard (1) into Hazard (2) or removing Hazard (1) entirely).

You can also spread an existing fire to an adjacent 5-space-radius.

Your control over the fire lasts until the start of your next turn, after which the fire returns to normal, though extinguished fires do not return.

While this spell is active, you can use an Action to manipulate the flames again, selecting the same target or a new target as you wish. If you select a new target, you relinquish control over the previous target.

Each extra success extends the duration of your control by +1 rounds.
